[Model: Claude Opus 4.5 | Temperature: 1.76 | Top P: 0.38]

Genre: "Cinematic rap, emo rap, alternative hip hop" Instruments: "moody piano, distorted synth bass, sparse trap drums, raw male vocal" Tags: "72 BPM; melancholic; intense; dark; passionate"

[Verse 1 | confessional rap vocal | close-mic'd delivery | sparse piano | dark synth undertones]
Twenty-five, but I feel like I’m done at twenty-one  
Woke up with a nosebleed, glass on the floor, sun’s barely up  
Phone full of missed calls, but I ain’t got the guts to answer one  
She used to call me her reason, now I’m just a fuck-up she runs from  
Pour another shot, powder on the dresser, I’m chasing numb  
Told myself I’d quit, but I lied, like I always done  
Every mirror in this place just shows me what I’m running from  
Can’t stand my own face, so I break it, and I blame it on the drugs

[Pre-Chorus | strained vocal | swelling strings | tension build]
I swear I tried, but trying’s just a word when you’re drowning  
She begged me to breathe, but I just kept counting  
Every pill, every bottle, every night I let her down  
Now she’s gone, and I’m stuck with this fucked up crown

[Chorus | anguished lead vocal | layered harmonies | cinematic drums | piano stabs]
I killed the only thing that ever loved me  
Traded her heart for a line and a fifth, now I’m ugly  
If I could go back, I’d burn every bridge I built from pain  
But I’m just a ghost in my own skin, lost in the rain  
I killed the only thing that ever loved me  
She tried to save me, but I dragged her down, now I’m nothing  
If I could go back, I’d rip out the part that can’t change  
But I’m just a ghost in my own skin, lost in the rain

[Verse 2 | raw rap vocal | heavy reverb | low piano | distant synths]
I remember her hands, shaking, begging me to stop  
I laughed it off, said I’m fine, but I was already lost  
I wore my trauma like a badge, wore her patience thin  
She saw the good in me, I just saw the bottle and the powder win  
Now my friends don’t call, my mom don’t sleep  
I keep telling myself, “Tomorrow I’ll eat, tomorrow I’ll clean”  
But tomorrow’s just a rerun, same scene, same script  
Another promise broken, another vein I rip

[Bridge | half-sung, half-rapped | distorted vocal layer | strings swell]
If you’re listening, I’m sorry, I know it’s too late  
I’m the reason you’re gone, I’m the reason I hate  
Every second I breathe, every night I wake  
I’m the punchline to a joke I can’t escape

[Chorus | anguished lead vocal | layered harmonies | cinematic drums | piano stabs]
I killed the only thing that ever loved me  
Traded her heart for a line and a fifth, now I’m ugly  
If I could go back, I’d burn every bridge I built from pain  
But I’m just a ghost in my own skin, lost in the rain  
I killed the only thing that ever loved me  
She tried to save me, but I dragged her down, now I’m nothing  
If I could go back, I’d rip out the part that can’t change  
But I’m just a ghost in my own skin, lost in the rain

[Outro | whispered vocal | fading piano | ambient noise]
I’m just a ghost in my own skin  
Lost in the rain  
Just a ghost in my own skin  
Lost in the rain

artist_name: Eminem  on Space Bound, core_theme: The main character blames himself for having screwed up hi;s life and regrets not becoming the person he wanted to be life and regrets not becoming the person he wanted to be;
 he’s almost 25 now, he’s addicted to drugs (powder), alcohol,  probably to escape reality, since he sees no meaning in his life, but most of all he regrets that because of his own screw-ups  he lost the very girl who loved him with all her heart and  tried to keep him from going down the wrong path, optional_mood_tag: Melancholic, intense, fatalistic, dark, desperate, passionate, cinematic., banned_words: void, echoes, hollow, fractures, stardust, infinite, transcend, resonate, ignite, sanctify, sanctified, glorified, boundless, eternal, awaken, embers, horizon, eclipse, decimation, consecration, canonize, anomaly, righteous, prophecy, salvation, algorithm, frequency, static, signal, erase
, length_hint: single, explicit_language: yes, rhyme_density: 85%, rhyme_complexity: 90%, rhyme_schemes: End rhyme, Internal rhyme, Perfect rhyme, Slant rhyme, Assonance, Multisyllabic rhyme, Free/irregular, Free verse, Ballad, Cross-line rhyme
Themes and Emotional Palette :
The main character blames himself for having screwed up hi;s life and regrets not becoming the person he wanted to be life and regrets not becoming the person he wanted to be;
 he’s almost 25 now, he’s addicted to drugs (powder), alcohol,  probably to escape reality, since he sees no meaning in his life, but most of all he regrets that because of his own screw-ups  he lost the very girl who loved him with all her heart and  tried to keep him from going down the wrong path

Flow, Rhyme Habits, and Rhythmic Quirks
The delivery features a variable cadence that mirrors the emotional instability of the narrative. It begins with a conversational, weary flow and escalates into rapid-fire, staccato bursts (chopper-style influence). The track is characterized by heavy internal rhyme chaining and an intricate use of assonance to maintain momentum even when the rhythm shifts.

Persona, Vocal Style, and Signatures
The vocal performance transitions from a hushed, raspy intimacy in the verses to an aggressive, strained delivery during the climax. A signature element is the contrast between the raw, gritty rap verses and a soaring, melodic, clean-vocal chorus that provides a grand, space-themed metaphorical relief to the grounded violence of the story.

[Model: Claude Opus 4.5 | Temperature: 1.8 | Top P: 0.38]

Genre: "cinematic hip hop, alternative rap, emo rap" Instruments: "dark piano, orchestral strings, distorted 808s, live drums, layered male vocals (raspy to strained), melodic chorus with autotune" Tags: "72 BPM; melancholic; intense; dynamic flow; passionate; spacey reverb"

[Verse 1 | hushed, raspy rap vocal | dark piano + strings | slow, syncopated drums | intimate delivery]
Twenty-five, yeah, I’m still here, barely—  
White lines, brown bottle, can’t steer clearly  
Mom said, “Son, you got a future,” I said, “Yeah, I know,”  
But I traded that shit for a numb little glow  
Now I’m stuck in this room, walls closing in,  
Same old excuses, can’t blame the gin  
She tried to save me, I pushed her away  
Now she’s gone, and I’m stuck with the mess I made  
I was too proud, too loud, too high to listen  
She begged me to quit, but I kept on sniffin’  
Said, “I’ll change tomorrow,” but tomorrow never came  
Just another broken promise, just another damn shame  
I’m staring at the ceiling, chasing ghosts in the plaster  
Every second I’m alive, I’m just dying a little faster  
I see her in my dreams, she’s screaming, “Wake up!”  
But I’m lost in the powder, and I can’t shake the shake-up

[Pre-Chorus | strained vocal | orchestral build | heavy reverb | tension rising]
I know I fucked it up, yeah, I know I did  
Tried to be a man, but I’m just a scared kid  
If I could turn it back, I’d give it all away  
But I’m stuck in this skin, and I can’t escape

[Chorus | soaring melodic vocal | layered harmonies | cinematic strings | big drums | spacey FX]
I’m space bound, drifting, lost in my own head  
Wish I could land, but I’m light years from the bed  
She was gravity, pulling me down to earth  
Now I’m floating, fucked up, and it hurts  
I’m space bound, burning up, can’t find my way  
I’d give anything just to hear her say  
“You’re not alone,” but I’m too far gone  
And I’m the reason she’s gone, I’m the reason she’s gone

[Verse 2 | rapid-fire, chopper-style rap | distorted 808s | aggressive delivery | emotional escalation]
I’m a car crash in slow motion, can’t rewind the tape  
I keep snorting my regrets, can’t escape the taste  
Tried to fill the hole with poison, tried to drown the ache  
But the more I run, the more I break  
I remember her hands, soft on my face  
Telling me, “Baby, you’re more than this place”  
But I spit in her faith, yeah, I pissed on her trust  
Now I’m choking on the dust of everything I fucked up  
Every call I ignored, every lie I sold  
Every “I’m fine” when I was ice cold  
She was the only one who saw the kid behind the rage  
Now I’m scribbling apologies on a torn-out page  
If I could bleed out the powder, if I could sweat out the gin  
If I could go back to then, I’d let her in  
But I’m locked in this loop, and the loop’s getting tighter  
Every night’s a fight, every high’s just a lighter

[Bridge | cracked, vulnerable vocal | minimal piano | emotional breakdown]
I know you tried, I know you cried  
I know you prayed for me at night  
But I was too far gone to see the light  
Now I’m just a ghost in my own life

[Chorus | soaring melodic vocal | layered harmonies | cinematic strings | big drums | spacey FX]
I’m space bound, drifting, lost in my own head  
Wish I could land, but I’m light years from the bed  
She was gravity, pulling me down to earth  
Now I’m floating, fucked up, and it hurts  
I’m space bound, burning up, can’t find my way  
I’d give anything just to hear her say  
“You’re not alone,” but I’m too far gone  
And I’m the reason she’s gone, I’m the reason she’s gone

[Outro | whispered vocal | distant reverb | sparse piano]
I’m sorry, I’m sorry, I’m sorry  
But sorry don’t bring you back  
I’m just a man with a pocket full of ashes  
And a head full of tracks
